system.specialAbility: Panache: held on a critical Strike, a Feint, or a Demoralize; +1 Situation to Evade and +1 ft to your Speeds while you hold it (Speed +2 ft at Expert, Evade +2 at Master, Speed +3 ft at Legendary).
system.description: Grants Training in Acrobatics, and 3 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.
